# OpenCode Workbench (opencode-workbench)

> Open-source (MIT) MCP server + connector that provisions and clones the OpenCode
> workbench onto Linux machines — locally or over SSH. Eleven tools cover a
> kernel-up platform scan, a one-call bootstrap, an idempotent, consent-gated
> clone, the install/update/remove lifecycle, and value-blind credential guidance.
> No secret values are ever read, transmitted, or written.

## Connect

- Local stdio server: `npx -y @simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench`
- Hosted (Streamable HTTP): `https://opencode-workbench.simonmak.com/mcp`
- Homepage: https://opencode-workbench.simonmak.com
- Glama: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench
- Context7 library ID: `/simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench`

## MCP tools (11)

- `get_workbench_info` — describe this server: repo, components by tier, optional MCP add-ons
- `inspect_target` — probe a machine: OS, arch, package manager, Node, Docker, OpenCode, home and npm-global paths
- `plan_clone` — diff the target against the profile → install / present / manual steps (with command previews)
- `apply_clone` — consent-gated: without `confirm:true` returns the plan; with it, clones + installs the profile (idempotent)
- `verify_clone` — re-check config, env template, and every component's detection
- `install_component` — install a single component by id (also `confirm`-gated)
- `remove_component` — uninstall a single component by id (bounded subset; `confirm`-gated)
- `update_component` — update/upgrade a single component in place (`confirm`-gated)
- `list_required_credentials` — value-blind: which credentials are missing and how to acquire each
- `run_auth_flow` — emit-and-verify acquisition guidance for one credential
- `bootstrap_host` — one-call provisioning: kernel-up platform scan + dry-run upgrade plan, latest-stable OpenCode with recorded version, apply + verify; `help:true` documents every parameter without touching the target

Every tool takes a `target`:

```json
{ "target": { "mode": "ssh", "host": "<your-box>", "user": "<your-user>", "identityFile": "~/.ssh/id_ed25519" } }
```

`apply_clone` options: `components[]`, `workspace`, `profileUrl`, `skipRepo`, `dryRun`, `confirm`.
`bootstrap_host` options: `help`, `confirm`, `upgrade`, `assumeYes`, `opencodeVersion`, `dryRun`.

## Quality

- Tool descriptions target the Tool Definition Quality Score (TDQS); `mcp-tdqs lint` reports 0 errors.
- CI: `mcp-server.yml` (build/typecheck/test), `secret-scan.yml` (gitleaks),
  `validate-docs.yml`, `validate-inventory.yml` (config/doc parity).
